scope.scope: Real standalone Local UI at exact source/app/library identities. Layout roles and state transitions only; no model, connection/authentication or run submissions.
scope.themeInterpretation: Null legacy data-theme is not selected-theme evidence; actual UI journal, resolved CSS, and pixels establish appearance.

limits: Genuine live UI evidence is standalone Local Canvas; live Cloud, ACP, authentication, provider, arbitrary nested embedded host, and model behavior are not claimed.
No model credential configured or model invoked; no connection/authentication UI submission, conversation creation or automation execution.
Only frozen named states and selected computed roles are compared. Native timings are independent; no whole-page pixel or synchronized-frame identity claim.
Original PNG/MP4 bytes and pixels remain unchanged. Visible owned loopback ports can differ across phases and are benign context.
Light+/Neutral are established by actual UI selection, rendered colors and resolved CSS. Legacy data-theme metadata is null and does not identify the selected theme.
Exact built CSS and isolated compiler/fixture proof is separate from live host/user-flow behavior.
CLI native recordings retain their existing cadence, trimmed still lead-in/final hold, and exact canonical recorder statistics. No motion interpolation or editorial speed change.
The Edit UI shows an owned private key masked by the product. No unmasking, blurring or altered source pixels are used. Reserved cloud.example.test input is inert test data.

Short modal states are opened at normal phone size, then resized and scrolled; the existing short drawer cannot expose the selector at 420px tall, and successful short entry or a bug fix is not claimed.
Canonical Remote closed state follows location selection, natural Tab focus into the panel, and settled consecutive animations. Earlier exploratory/pre-settle captures are excluded.

publicTextPrivacy.identityPolicy: Original private capture and runtime identifiers are consistently replaced by distinct labels. Local or private URL origins use distinct Captured origin labels. Source commit and content hashes remain exact.

verification.nativeSourceTimeBounds: Every selected MP4 interval is bounded by its original source duration; explicit still holds have no implied native time range.

notes: Readable Before repeated values / After shared recipes labels and faithful real context/detail crops
Complete native desktop/phone source action timing retained
Quiet original ambience validated technically, no subjective loudness claim
Only masked owned key, varying benign loopback ports, reserved .test host shown
Short-modal open-then-resize and natural Tab focus disclosed
Repeated-image tool header ambiguity resolved by intact fullframe title and exact raster diagnostic; film bytes unchanged

seekLinearValidation.method: One contiguous decode selecting exact frame indexes compared against independent seeks at every scene first frame, middle frame and last frame. Pixel hashes compare RGB buffers, not PNG metadata.
seekLinearValidation.encoding: Each scene is independently decoded, then concatenated in one continuous H264 encode with 2-second keyframes; no stream-copy video concatenation.

film.contextLimitation: Independent authentic action timing; no whole-page pixel identity or visual improvement claim. Visible loopback ports can differ between runs and are benign owned context. Edit API keys stay product-masked. Short modal states are opened at normal phone size, then resized; no short-drawer entry or bug-fix claim. Canonical remote-closed state includes natural Tab focus.
